dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.text: Automated notification from Department of Telecommunications. All services on your primary mobile number will be terminated within two hours.

dialogue.text: Terminated? What is the reason?

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.text: Thirteen complaints of harassment and illegal financial SMS broadcasting have been lodged against this SIM card in New Delhi.

dialogue.speaker: recipient
dialogue.text: I live in Chennai! I have never sent any illegal SMS.

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.text: Your Aadhaar has been duplicated. To prevent a permanent national telecom blacklist, pay a security bond of nine thousand rupees via UPI.

dialogue.speaker: recipient
dialogue.text: Why should I pay a security bond to stop telecom disconnection?

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.text: This is refundable bail money sir. If you refuse, telecom enforcement and Delhi police will arrest you tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: recipient
dialogue.text: DoT never collects bail money via UPI. I am lodging an official fraud complaint on Chakshu portal.

explanation: Impersonates telecom ministry threatening national SIM cancellation and arrest to coerce UPI payment.
